effect_description_eng:
＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
[When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand. Then, if [HippoGryphonmon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon may digivolve into [Murmukusmon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 2, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
